topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I heard tell of a young man, one of the new ones who tries to capture beauty on paper, who found his work etched not on walls nor scrolls, but upon the flesh of another. Aye, it were a shock, I reckon, to see his hand's work bound forever to the skin of a stranger. What does one say to such a thing? To see your creation, your very breath, fixed in a place you never intended, never dreamed? The world's got a way of twisting your plans, like a young shoot bent by harsh winds. I pray to Saint Christopher that the man finds his path, for the road ahead seems as dark as the ink that won't wash away.
